description: This Java source file defines the class FullHttpRequestToMockServerHttpRequest, which maps Netty's FullHttpRequest objects to custom HttpRequest objects within the MockServer framework. It handles request parsing, headers, cookies, body, and socket addresses.

classes.name: FullHttpRequestToMockServerHttpRequest
classes.description: A class that converts Netty's FullHttpRequest objects into MockServer's HttpRequest objects, extracting headers, cookies, body, and socket information.

methods.name: mapFullHttpRequestToMockServerRequest
methods.description: Maps a FullHttpRequest to a MockServer HttpRequest, handling headers, cookies, body, and socket addresses.

methods.name: setSocketAddress
methods.description: Sets the socket address information on the HttpRequest based on the provided addresses and headers.

methods.name: setMethod
methods.description: Sets the HTTP method on the HttpRequest.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Extracts and sets the request path from the URI.

methods.name: setQueryString
methods.description: Extracts and sets query parameters from the URI.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Copies headers from the FullHttpRequest to the HttpRequest, including preserved headers and HTTP/2 stream ID.

methods.name: setCookies
methods.description: Decodes and sets cookies from the request headers.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the request body by decoding the content buffer.
